issues.issue: Clip 01 is the row the inspector is editing (37.2 matches 'Best clip 37.2/40') but its Keep / Maybe / Skip line shows no chosen value, while clip 02 shows 'Keep' with a checkmark inside an outline; selection and triage state cannot be told apart at a glance.

In the Style control the second swatch row leaves the four-column grid the tabs set: 'Custom' sits under the Pop/Cinema gap rather than under 'Cinema', and 'Orange' is a few pixels off the 'Lime' column.

The export cluster under the caption sets 'Download MP4' as a bold underlined action and 'SRT | VTT | Meta | Poster' as 11 px gray labels joined by pipe characters, so four sibling exports read as breadcrumbs rather than one control family.
'AI Tools' is printed twice within 60 px, once as the panel header and once as the active rail tab with a pressed gray card, so one label means both a panel and its toggle.
The 'Last Viewed' column header wraps to two lines while Name, Duration and Created stay on one, and its sort chevron aligns to the first line only, so the header row gains a stray second baseline.
The player bar mixes four type sizes in one 40 px row: an ~11 px timecode, a 13 px zoom value, a 15 px 'Split' and ~10 px ruler labels, so controls at the same level do not read as a set.

On ENG-139 the six label pills eat the right half of the row, truncating the title to 'Identify Missing Data ...' and clipping the first pill mid-label ('1.'), so title and labels collide in the same line.
The right panel's top row pairs a text tab ('Properties') with two bare icon tabs (link, copy-ID, branch) and marks none of them active, so one tab set has two different shapes.
Label pills mix three mark styles at the same size: emoji-style colored glyphs (orange gear for MIC Release, red diamond for Internal Release), flat dots (yellow, gray, blue) and avatar stacks.
The whole 'Auto headline' announcement, both lines from 'A headline has been added...' to '...go to "Edit Clip"', is set in a monospace face while every other label on the screen is sans.
Each clip's only actions are three unlabeled ~16 px icons (captions, download, scissors) sitting in a row under the score, with no text label and no single primary, so the next step is guesswork.

'Disable it' is parked at the far right of the Auto headline banner, roughly 700 px from the sentence it acts on and about 40 px from the banner's × close, so two different dismissals sit side by side.

The third 'Ready-made collections' card is cut mid-word ('Educati') at the panel edge and a carousel chevron is drawn on top of the clipped label, so the row overflows with no usable scroll affordance.

Three unlabeled identifier strings ('d591db2c-0a82-482e-a8c8-5f93768b9a24', '69e48d8e849ab9426f17022d', 'composer-5gohk1e06') sit between the tab bar and the 'Tracks' heading, reading as leaked debug output above the page's main heading.

The Transcript row ends its list with a different control set from every track row above it: 'Copy' plus 'Download' plus a bare '?' button and no '...' menu, so the last row of one list uses a second pattern.

The promo card on the right ('Auto removal - Remove backgrounds in one click') is the same size, saturation and rounded-rect shape as the 'Create project' gradient panel, so two entry points contest the top of the page.
A 98x57 image block sits unlabeled at the top of the left rail above 'Video editing', with no caption, action or border, reading as an image that failed to load.

The media tab row mixes three icon languages at one size: a filled cyan play glyph (Media), uniform outline glyphs (Audio, Stickers, Effects, Transitions, Filters) and the letterform 'TI' standing in for Text.

notes: P5 is the only product with an error screen, and it is a good one, so empty/error for the other five is scored from the state coverage visible in their cliplist and editor screens; no product showed a true empty state. P2's cliplist was captured with a context menu open under a full-screen dimming overlay, which hides its hover, selection and column states.
